name: autologger-mcp
description: Read and write autologger session data (studios, shows, sessions, events, transcripts, topics, wiki pages, dashboards) through autologger's MCP endpoint: OAuth sign-in, token refresh, MCP tool calls, a wiki-link checker, export/import to seed a local dev stack from another server, and a local index to find moments about a topic and map a person across sessions, all in a TypeScript CLI.
